import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_definition import Cut

def dimuon_mask(events, params, **kwargs):
    """
    Dimuon preselection cut.
    Requires at least 2 muons with pT above threshold and opposite-charge leading pair.
    """
    pt_threshold = params["pt_threshold"]
    
    # Select muons passing pT threshold
    muons = events.Muon[events.Muon.pt > pt_threshold]
    
    # At least 2 muons required
    has_two_muons = ak.num(muons) >= 2
    
    # Leading pair must have opposite charge
    leading_pair_opp_charge = ak.fill_none(
        muons[:, 0].charge * muons[:, 1].charge < 0,
        False
    )
    
    return has_two_muons & leading_pair_opp_charge

# Declare cut with framework's cut-definition object
dimuon = Cut(
    name="dimuon",
    function=dimuon_mask,
    params={"pt_threshold": 15}
)
